adjudication.depicted_input: Fine-tuning schematic for the ST FM showing a Single Cell FM adapted using the HEST1K dataset into a Spatial Transcriptomics FM.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the fine_tuning route. It visibly shows the route-specific training input source object (HEST1K ST data) and its immediate fine-tuning interface into the ST foundation model. Under the atlas rules, the crop does not need to display explicit gene-token/value/condition-token internals when the figure clearly depicts the source input object and fine-tuning transformation supplied to the model. This inset is the paper’s dedicated ST-FM fine-tuning panel and supports the listed route.
